diagnosed: REAL, recurring breakage (also found 2026-07-29) — every ESCALATION of the research agent fails 100%. The split is clean: all `schedule`-triggered research-agent.yml runs SUCCEED; all `workflow_dispatch`-triggered runs FAIL. Latest evidence: run 30519765351 (2026-07-30T06:30, workflow_dispatch, failure) vs run 30521xxxxx (2026-07-30T06:41, schedule, success). Older failures 30335112817 (07-28) and 30251982133/30308235522 (07-27), all workflow_dispatch, same error. Failure: `##[error]Action failed with error: Workflow initiated by non-human actor: github-actions (type: Bot). Add bot to allowed_bots list or use '*' to allow all bots.` Root cause: scout / coverage-critic escalate research via scripts/escalate-research.js -> `gh workflow run research-agent.yml` using the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (deliberate — it carries actions:write, unlike the agent's OIDC app token; WP-91). A GITHUB_TOKEN dispatch runs with actor github-actions[bot], and anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 rejects bot actors unless allow-listed. research-agent.yml sets no `allowed_bots` on any of its three claude-code-action steps, so 100% of escalations die on arrival — the scout/coverage-critic -> research escalation fast lane (a core coverage feature) is entirely non-functional. Worse, escalate-research.js sees the dispatch return HTTP 200 and reports success (even closing any open `escalation-failed` alarm), so the failure is invisible except as a red workflow_dispatch run.

FIX IS HUMAN-REQUIRED (protected path). Minimal root-cause fix: add `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` to the `with:` block of each anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 step in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml (standard-tier ~line 79, deep Fable-5 ~line 102, deep Opus-fallback ~line 130). Scope to `github-actions`, NOT '*': this is a PUBLIC repo and the action's docs/security.md warns '*' lets external Apps invoke the action with prompts they control. The action's allowed_bots input accepts a comma-separated list of bot logins or '*'.

I could not author this fix: .github/workflows/** is a protected automation path and the CI-only protect-automation hook (scripts/hooks/protect-automation.js) BLOCKS any unattended agent from writing it — 'a protected-path change must be authored by a human, not any unattended agent.' The hook fired on the Edit attempt; the branch was left clean and deleted, no PR opened. This supersedes self-repair.md's older 'still make it, it'll wait for review' prose (that prose predates the harness-level hook).

No non-protected alternative fix exists: the escalation is inherently bot-triggered (any GITHUB_TOKEN dispatch -> github-actions[bot]); the only other route (a human-actor PAT with actions:write) needs a new secret AND still edits protected workflow steps. The workflow allowed_bots line is the smallest correct fix.
Not the governor's job: usage-state.json is green (session 5%, week 25%, skipAll/skipNiceToHave false) — these are hard rejections of every escalation, not quota skips.

Everything else is healthy: `npm test` 1368 passing (81 files), `node scripts/validate-events.js` clean (0 errors; only pre-existing non-fatal chess-timezone-bleed + one streaming-missing + WP-246/WP-242 basis WARNINGS).
